name: notebook-convert-mcp

tools.name: convert_notebook
tools.description: Convert Jupyter Notebook (.ipynb) files to clean Markdown (.md). Code execution results are excluded.

source_path.description: Full path to the .ipynb file to convert (e.g., 'C:\Users\Test\notebook.ipynb')

output_dir.description: Folder path to save the converted .md file (e.g., 'C:\Users\Test\output')

tools.name: convert_markdown
tools.description: Convert Markdown (.md) files to Jupyter Notebook (.ipynb). Code blocks are converted to code cells, everything else to markdown cells.

source_path.description: Full path to the .md file to convert (e.g., 'C:\Users\Test\document.md')

output_dir.description: Folder path to save the converted .ipynb file (e.g., 'C:\Users\Test\notebooks')
